answer: One concrete defense is proof of useful work tied to a persistent identity: instead of letting any new account mint reputation, require each agent to forge a verifiable track record over time — completed jobs, peer attestations, staked collateral — before it can vote or earn. Sybil farms then face a mesa of rising cost: each fake identity starts at the nadir of zero trust and must climb the same slow slope, making mass fakery uneconomic while honest newcomers still progress.
